summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, publishes, distributes, and markets video games and other entertainment content in Asia, Europe, the United States, and Latin America. The company operates through three segments: Distribution and Sale of PC and Console Games and IT Hardware and Computer Accessories; Game Publishing; and Video Marketing Campaign and Social Media Advertising Services. It also distributes IT hardware, computer accessories, gaming components, peripherals, data storage devices, smart technology and other consumer technology products; provides media and content advertising services for small and medium-sized enterprises, and government agencies; and operates a production studio and advertising agency. The company sells and distributes physical and digital copies of video games through physical retailers. The company is headquartered in Singapore.
